title: A living greeting allows unknown words

captions.physics: Discussing a possible sincere shared reply
captions.emotions: Feeling lightness before words are settled

meaning: You can discuss a possible sincere shared reply and rely on the accepted value of responding, feeling lightness before a remark has its final words.
text: The Star in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in discussing a possible sincere shared reply. The Hierophant in energy supports the accepted value of responding: actually acknowledging someone matters rather than only observing outward form. The Fool in emotions brings lightness before words are ready and freedom to begin without a model. You can hope for a form of your own without knowing how it will sound. Openness does not replace a promise where one has already been given.

Suppose you say you would like to answer good wishes in your own words one day, without a familiar joint phrase. Discussing a particular message, you remember what especially touched you. **A sincere answer can begin without a prepared model**. There is lightness in not immediately producing a flawless remark. An accepted value of gratitude remains supportive while its expression stays open. Yet the new wording need not be unusual; familiar words can also be genuine when both choose them.

Difficulty arises if freedom from a model becomes endless waiting for a special answer. Lightness then conceals that a real message remains unacknowledged. The constructive Hierophant helps return to the accepted value of gratitude without prescribing one correct formula. You can answer honestly with simple words and preserve room for novelty; sincerity requires neither compulsory originality nor promising a phrase that will eventually say absolutely everything.
